Dear Actief Oostkamp team,

I am applying for the Warehouse Worker night shift position in Oostkamp. While my recent professional focus has been in digital marketing, I bring direct warehouse experience from Katoen Natie in Antwerp, where I worked in a high-volume, fast-paced logistics environment. That role taught me the importance of accuracy, efficiency, and teamwork under pressure.

I understand this position involves loading and unloading trucks, quality checks, and keeping the warehouse organised and safe. I am physically fit, not afraid of cold environments, and eager to learn to operate an electrical pallet truck. I would also welcome the opportunity to receive internal reach truck training and take on more responsibility over time.

I am a genuine night owl who performs best during night hours. I have my own transportation to Oostkamp and already live in Belgium with legal permission to work. I am available to start as soon as possible.

Thank you for considering my application. I look forward to the opportunity to discuss how I can add value to your night shift team.

Sincerely,
